name: Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas
original_name: Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas
overview:
Anna Stadler and Drew Ater in Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas (2024)

A powerful CEO is mistaken for a poor salesman when he enters a contract marriage with a company boss. During Christmas dinner with her family, he faces mockery but proves his worth and finds love.
